purpose: Teach: 見え隠れ/王位/財投/先立ち/国務省/血縁/検疫/受難

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、組織内の派閥が見え隠れする時期史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered the history of factional tensions within organizations in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely interested. Leans forward slightly. Steady eye contact. The tone of a teacher who has actually read the work and wants the student to know it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、王位継承を巡る戦争史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered the history of succession wars for the throne.
lines.style: Direct, clear. Slight forward pitch — eager to answer correctly. No flourish, just factual precision. The voice of someone who knows her material.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 財投を使った戦後復興を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You explored postwar reconstruction through fiscal investment policies in another one, yes?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle confirmation, not interrogation. The rhythm of someone piecing together a larger picture.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、近代化に先立ち行われた制度改革を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the institutional reforms that preceded modernization.
lines.style: Steady, assured. No hesitation. The quiet confidence of someone who has done thorough research and is presenting it without apology.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 米国国務省の対日政策史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined US State Department policy toward Japan during that period?
lines.style: Alert, genuinely curious now. Slight uptick in energy. Recognizing the scope of the work. Collaborative tone — we're mapping this together.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、血縁関係を巡る相続問題を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I addressed succession disputes arising from kinship and inheritance matters.
lines.style: Clear, direct response. Slight upward inflection on the opening word — confirming. Measured pace. The voice of someone tracking a complex lineage without losing the thread.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 検疫制度の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the history of quarantine systems — you went there too?
lines.style: Impressed undertone. Slight smile in the voice. Admiration mixed with gentle amazement at the breadth. Conversational, not performative.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、宗教者の受難史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the history of religious persecution and suffering.
lines.style: Quiet, steady close. Slight gravitas on the subject matter — this one carried weight. Not triumphant, just complete. The exhale of having covered difficult material well.
